question: A man goes to Ahmedabad from Kolkata at a speed of 9 km/hr and returns to Kolkata at speed of 18 km/hr, through same route. What is his average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When equal distances are covered in both directions at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y)

Here, outward speed x = 9 km/hr and return speed y = 18 km/hr.

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 9 × 18) ÷ (9 + 18)

⇒ Average Speed = 324 ÷ 27 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 km/hr.**
